chapter: The McShann band on the road and at the Savoy
title: Pianists Bob Merrill and Skip Hall
summary: Bob Merrill filled in at piano and Skip Hall travelled as arranger before entering service.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well, didn't you have a piano player?
Yeah, we had Skip Hall. No, we didn't have Skip Hall, we -- I think we had Bob Merrill playing the piano then, because Bob had come back from Earl Hines. Yeah.
Bob Merrill. He was banging on the piano.
Yeah, because Skip had gone into the service then.
Well, when Skip Hall was around that band, did he play piano?
Sometimes McShean would walk off and Skip was glad to get over there and play.
But did he travel with you as an arranger then?
